en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a dramatic mountain range (the Dolomites) behind a valley with partially destroyed multi‑story buildings and a church tower. The ruins line a road or wall in the foreground, suggesting war damage. Printed Italian text labels the scene, mentioning San Martino di Castrozza, the Grand Hôtel des Alpes burned by Austrians in May 1915, and the mountain Sass Maor with its elevation.
